resources.string: Point the camera at the horizon, then tap Start Capture and turn slowly on the spot. The ring at top shows how much of the turn is left — capture finishes automatically once you complete the loop.
Tap at least 8 points spread around the panorama before finishing.
Camera permission is required to survey the horizon.
Location is optional. If granted, it is used only to correct compass readings to true north (magnetic declination); it is never stored or exported.
Discard the panorama and all %1$d recorded points?
This device has no compass/orientation sensor.
Tap the horizon to check its coordinates
